port_note: Port released training-free pseudo-inverse temporal-kernel resizing plus norm scaling to Qwen3 patch Conv3d; retain Qwen3 bias, DeepStack, position embeddings and textual timestamps. Not an official Qwen3 FlexiVideo checkpoint.
caveat: Within-model comparisons; architecture, model size and image resize differ, so model-to-model changes are not a timestamp-only causal test.
